selected_observations.excerpt:
Counterparty: Oakfield Logistics GmbH
Effective: 1 September 2018
Term: rolling 12-month periods.
This agreement is silent on change of control.

selection_rationale: Change-of-control consent must be grounded in explicit CoC language in MSA-OAK-2018.
known_missing_information: Silence on CoC (e.g. Oakfield) must be modeled via REJECT, not closed-world negation per KERNEL.
